protocol: HOT3D anatomical MANO21, native left optical, metric, no alignment
mask_input: supplied SAM2 masks_modal, mask-conditioned experiment; amodal masks forbidden

object_pose.method: multi-start convex mesh silhouette support fitting

hand.model: MANO right, predicted median subject shape, WiLoR articulation initialization

selection: Minimize mean development capped100mm missing-penalty score across collision/contact; use shared weight to isolate adding contact; freeze before held-out hand runs
oracle: reference object transforms only; identical mask, object selection and estimated-pose acceptance; no hand GT
limitations: Existing held-out cohort reused as a controlled regression set, not a fresh confirmation cohort
ContactOpt-inspired geometric contact, not its learned predictor
